title: Intelligent Optimal Control of Rydberg Gates with Incremental-Update Deep Reinforcement Learning
summary: Deep reinforcement learning (DRL), acting as a novel and powerful paradigm for quantum optimal control, offers transformative opportunities for advancing neutral-atom quantum computing. In this work, we theoretically demonstrate a DRL-based framework for realizing Rydberg controlled-NOT gates that achieve both high speed and high fidelity through the synchronous modulation of multiple pulse parameters without any prior heuristic ansatz.
